canon_ref.note: Leaving Toren to mind a furious Lyonette and the inn, Erin rides Magnolia's magical coach roughly four hours to her vast, golem-guarded estate outside Invrisil, warming up to the butler Reynold along the way.

b2.erin_travels_to_magnolias_estate.summary: Leaving Toren to mind a furious Lyonette and the closed inn, Erin rides Magnolia's magical coach for hours to her vast, golem-guarded estate outside Invrisil, warming up to the butler Reynold along the way.

canon_ref.note: Ressa leads Erin to a guest wing holding seven more people pulled from Earth about a week ago near a Chicago airport (Joseph, Rose and others), plus Imani, a separate survivor of a group wiped out by monsters called Crelers. Erin bonds with Imani over her own first night here.

b2.erin_meets_the_new_earth_arrivals.summary: Magnolia's Head Maid Ressa leads Erin to a guest wing holding seven more people pulled from Earth about a week ago, plus a separate, traumatized survivor, Imani, whose whole group was wiped out by monsters called Crelers; Erin bonds with Imani over her own first night here.
